blocks_9: Narrow navigation consumes too much space and truncates identities; wide layouts leave the reading column detached from the list.
Supporting text is consistently small, while calendar and Calls lack a strong task-first detail hierarchy.
Polish is uneven in recipient selection, first-run composition, composer clipping/thumbnails, and dialog spacing.

issues: Account identities have nearly identical visual treatment; organisation is relegated to small email text.
Menu is long and nearly touches the bottom edge.
Meeting title has little more emphasis than list labels.
Two metadata rows and a generic explanatory paragraph leave the detail pane visually underdeveloped.
Large blank interval separates the meeting header from conversation start.
Small control pills and event labels compete in a very narrow panel.
Large blank interval above the conversation makes the sparse history feel detached from its header.
Event metadata has almost the same spacing budget as actual messages.
Several recent-person names truncate despite substantial unused vertical space.
Explanatory prose occupies more emphasis than the actions for calling people.
The main pane reads like a help article beneath the join form.
Small call icons provide little hierarchy for the primary person-based action.
Navigation consumes 296 of 760 pixels, leaving heavily wrapped thread content.
Thread cards and reply buttons create substantial enclosure in a constrained reading area.
Repeated card boundaries and reply buttons add visual weight to every post.
Small timestamps and helper text sit near the bottom of the readable scale.
Narrow-column empty-state guidance is quite small.
The central empty state has modest emphasis relative to the large empty pane.
Names and previews truncate in the fixed sidebar.
Conversation width is squeezed while persistent navigation retains a large share of the window.
The centred conversation leaves a roughly 350-pixel gulf from sidebar to message column.
Sidebar truncation persists despite the wide window.
Persistent composer instructions and timestamps are small.
Orange is shared by unread indicators, selected navigation, and selected reactions, weakening semantic specificity.
Very wide and very tall image thumbnails have tiny identifiable content inside equal-sized tiles.
Dimension captions dominate the small amount of useful thumbnail content.
A partially clipped text line is visible immediately inside the top composer edge.
The composer scrollbar is conspicuously darker/lighter than the history scrollbar and sits in a large reserved action gutter.
Suggestion popup is anchored to the left of the composer rather than near the typed mention.
Popup covers part of the last visible message.
Recovery is explicit and the failed message remains visible; the error sentence is small for an important failure.
Empty state has clear action but a very small heading and explanatory line in a large pane.
Loading feedback is clear; centre status text is small relative to the empty canvas.
Mention highlighting is clear; event descriptions and composer instructions are small.
Wide image dialog sits near the top while most of the lower window remains dimmed.
Zoom controls and image dimensions have very small type.
QR code is prominent and legible in both modes; Copy link feels detached in the lower right.
Highlighted candidate and primary button refer to different people, increasing interpretation effort.
Secondary explanation leaves the selected-recipient relationship implicit.
Action hierarchy is clear; permission name and consent qualification are small secondary text.
Clear result and keyboard hierarchy; result snippets truncate early and bottom guidance is small.
Large gap follows the notification helper, while later checkboxes use a tighter rhythm.
Account switching is described in small helper text rather than surfaced next to the account.
Bottom content is visibly cut off by the scroller.
Large brand lockup pushes a dense technical setup form into almost the entire window height.
Full-height scrollbar and bottom disclaimer make first run feel less composed than sign-in.
Unequal key-to-description gaps make the two columns scan at different rhythms.
Left column devotes a wide fixed gutter to combinations that are usually short.
Recovery controls and waiting status are clear; footer and supporting text are small.
Code is prominent; code-entry URL is embedded in a small prose paragraph.
Clear recovery and account context; logo is much stronger than the session-expired explanation.
Visible tooltip is a plausible pointer hover, not a layout defect.
Failure and retry are clear; error reason is small relative to branding.
Clear progress state; status card is visually subordinate to the large brand lockup.
Primary and fallback actions are clear; large branding outweighs practical sign-in content.
Visible tooltip is a plausible pointer hover, not a layout defect.
Focused field and disabled Save communicate state clearly; supporting explanation is small.
Tree is clear and calm; empty-pane guidance has little visual emphasis.

top_issues.issue: Narrow layouts retain too much navigation width, while identities and message text lose space.
top_issues.evidence: At 760 px width the content begins at x=296. Calls visibly truncates Katherine Jo..., Dorothy Vaug..., and Margaret Ha...; chats also truncates names and snippets.
top_issues.fix: Below 800 points use a collapsible list, with a 64-point rail and a back/list control; alternatively reduce list padding and put call actions on a second row so names remain readable.

top_issues.issue: The selected event lacks a strong detail hierarchy.
top_issues.evidence: At 1280x800 the event title occupies the 52-pixel header; metadata is only two rows in x=394..1114, y=78..178, followed by explanatory copy at y=202. Most of the pane is blank.
top_issues.fix: Use a 20-point event title and 15-point time/date directly above a compact metadata block; reserve generic joining guidance for applicable online meetings or a disclosure.

top_issues.issue: Too much useful guidance sits at the smallest end of the type scale.
top_issues.evidence: Composer instructions have about 11-pixel glyph height; timestamps and setup footer are similarly small. Native-size views are readable but demand more effort than the 14-point message bodies. Sampled helper colours pass contrast, so this is size and emphasis rather than a proven contrast failure.
top_issues.fix: Use 13-point supporting copy and 12-point timestamps; keep 11-point text for occasional category labels. Increase instruction line height to 18 points and shorten recurring composer instructions.

top_issues.issue: The Calls page gives the most content emphasis to implementation and capability prose.
top_issues.evidence: On the narrow screenshot the join panel is y=78..174, How calls work begins at y=202 and explanatory content continues to y=404. Per-person call actions are only small outline glyphs in the left list.
top_issues.fix: Keep one short 13-point description below Join; place the extended explanation under Details. Give a selected person a clear 32-point-high Call action in the main pane.

top_issues.issue: Selection state is ambiguous between the highlighted search result and the committed recipient.
top_issues.evidence: Barbara Liskov is highlighted at y=271..315, while the chosen chip is Grace Hopper at y=159 and the CTA says Chat with Grace Hopper. Enter to add explains the distinction only in small text.
top_issues.fix: Label chips Recipients and results Add a person; use an explicit Add control for the active result and a consistent Start chat CTA with recipient count.

top_issues.issue: First-run layout spends too much height on branding before a dense setup form.
top_issues.evidence: The logo/tagline occupy approximately y=20..167; the form spans y=201..667 and the disclaimer is at y=762. A scrollbar appears against the full right edge even at 1280x800.
top_issues.fix: Reduce the setup brand block to 96 points, use 24-point separation before the form, and keep 24-point lower safe padding. Maintain 14-point instructions and 32-point input heights.

top_issues.issue: The reading column feels disconnected from the conversation list on a wide window.
top_issues.evidence: At 1920x1080 the sidebar ends at x=364; messages begin around x=714 and body text at x=762. The list still truncates names/snippets despite the roughly 350-pixel empty gutter.
top_issues.fix: Use a 320..360-point adjustable chat list at wide sizes and reduce the leading content gutter to 48..96 points while keeping message measure around 760..860 points.

top_issues.issue: The scrolled composer has a rough clipped edge and inconsistent scrollbar treatment.
top_issues.evidence: At y=561 the previous draft line leaves a visible fragment just inside the top border; the scrollbar thumb at x=1166 is #1b1c1f in light and #e9e9ec in dark, stronger than the history scrollbar.
top_issues.fix: Clip text within an inner rectangle with 8-point top padding, add a 4-point edge fade for partial lines, and match composer thumb colour to the history scrollbar; keep a compact 32..40-point action gutter.

top_issues.issue: Equal thumbnail boxes obscure extreme-aspect-ratio attachments.
top_issues.evidence: The visible attachments include 3072x256 and 256x3072 images; their scaled contents become a thin horizontal row and a tiny vertical strip, unlike the identifiable square bird tile.
top_issues.fix: Keep 96-point previews but crop to fill with an aspect-ratio badge; show the complete image on open and add a 13-point filename rather than relying on dimensions alone.

top_issues.issue: Settings mixes incompatible vertical rhythms and exposes a clipped content tail.
top_issues.evidence: Notification label is near y=357, helper at y=386, next row y=422; following rows are near y=456 and 490. Content ends abruptly at y=697.
top_issues.fix: Use 16-point separation after a setting with helper copy and 12 points between simple rows. Add a 16-point lower inset and a subtle scroll-edge fade so continuation looks intentional.

top_issues.issue: Sparse call history floats far below its identifying header.
top_issues.evidence: In the 380x800 call bar the header ends at y=132 and the conversation-start text sits near y=248, leaving over 100 pixels of blank space before the history. The docked view shows the same pattern.
top_issues.fix: Place the start-of-conversation marker 24..32 points below the header for short histories; use 16-point event spacing and preserve clear separation before the composer.

top_issues.issue: Keyboard reference columns do not share a consistent scanning rhythm.
top_issues.evidence: Left descriptions start around x=390 after keycaps at x=201; right descriptions begin x=803 after keycaps at x=711. The left gutter is about twice the right gutter.
top_issues.fix: Use a shared 140-point key column and 16-point gap in each group, or split the long Zoom combination onto its own row. Keep 14-point descriptions and 34-point row rhythm.

top_issues.issue: Orange carries too many independent meanings.
top_issues.evidence: Orange appears in unread timestamps/dots, active rail icons, focus outlines, selected reactions, mentions and appearance controls. The neutral base is harmonious, but these states cannot be distinguished by colour alone.
top_issues.fix: Reserve #a5500f light / #e88c3e dark for focus, primary actions and mentions. Use weight plus a neutral unread dot for unread rows and neutral selected-reaction fills, retaining explicit selection outlines.
